tree.kind: the published package, minus the parts this project never runs

what.dist/: the built CLI: bundle/ and the data files it reads, the interactive themes among them
what.node_modules/@earendil-works/chord: imported by the bundle at runtime
what.node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node: imported by the bundle at runtime (image tools)
what.node_modules/typebox: imported by the bundle at runtime (schema validation)
what.package.json: the package's own manifest: version, bin, engines, dependencies
what.npm-shrinkwrap.json: the dependency tree pi publishes; kept for provenance and for a full install should one ever be wanted

omitted: *.map source maps (432 files, 6.5 MB): debug artifacts the runtime does not read

the rest of what npm installs from the shrinkwrap (166 MB in 91 packages). The bundle inlines most of them and names others in code paths a print run does not take; the three vendored packages are the ones our path imports
docs/ and examples/ (4.1 MB): shipped by the package, unread by a print run
verified: every vendored file is byte-identical to the file it was copied from, subtree hashes above
a live request through the vendored copy answers in about 1.6 s (deepseek/deepseek-flash, --print --no-tools)
used_by: src/commahum/pi_runner.py: runs vendor/pi/dist/bundle/cli.js with the node on PATH, unless $COMMAHUM_PI or a pi on PATH is asked for instead
tests/test_pi_runner.py: fails if this tree is missing from a checkout
drift_note: A pi feature outside the verified path may ask for a package that is not vendored. Node names the missing specifier when it happens, and the fix is to copy that package from the same source and extend the hashes above.
refresh: nix build nixpkgs#pi-coding-agent; copy dist/ (without .map), the three node_modules packages, package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json into vendor/pi/, then redo the subtree hashes
